There are no tests that run `poll_feed` itself, so the newly added logic in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb (SimpleRSS parsing, URL fallback `url = i.id if ...`, HTML unescape/scrub, and `TopicEmbed.import` calls) could break without any test failure. The finding’s wording about “stubs poll_feed, the method under test” is slightly off (the spec is effectively about `execute`), but the core concern (missing coverage for `poll_feed`) is real and diff-grounded.
